requests.description: This method queues collection of documents onto the server for analysis. Queued collection of documents analyzes in common context as entire thing. If unique configuration ID provided, Semantria uses settings of that configuration during analysis, in opposite the primary configuration uses. Collection IDs are unique in scope of configuration. If the same ID appears twice, Semantria overrides existing collection with the new Data
requests.name: Queue collection for analysis
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: This method retrieves analysis results for processed collections from Semantria. FAILED collections will have FAILED status in response. Semantria responds with limited amount of results per API call. If configuration ID provided, Semantria responds with the collections, which were queued using the same configuration ID, in opposite Primary configuration uses.
requests.name: Retrieve collections analysis
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: This method cancels collection analysis by unique ID on Semantria side if it is waiting for analysis in queue.
requests.name: Cancel collection analysis
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: This method retrieves analysis results for documents collection by its unique ID or the collection’s status in queue if it did not analyzed yet. Semantria guarantees delivering of all collections back to the client even if they FAILED on Semantria side due to some reason.
requests.name: Retrieve collection analysis or its status in queue
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
requests.summary: Retrieve collection analysis or its status in queue

requests.description: This method queues document onto the server for analysis. Queued document analyzes individually and will have its own set of results. If unique configuration ID provided, Semantria uses settings of that configuration during analysis, in opposite the primary configuration uses. Document IDs are unique in scope of configuration. If the same ID appears twice, Semantria overrides existing document with the new Data.
requests.name: Queue document for analysis
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: This method queues batch of documents for analysis. The rules are the same as for single document mode but here the documents ordered into the batch.
requests.name: Queue batch of documents for analysis
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
requests.summary: Queue batch of documents for analysis

requests.description: This method retrieves analysis results for processed documents from Semantria. FAILED documents will have FAILED status in response. Semantria responds with limited amount of results per API call. If configuration ID provided, Semantria responds with the document, which were queued using the same configuration ID, in opposite Primary.
requests.name: Retrieve documents analysis
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: This method cancels document analysis by unique ID on Semantria side if it is waiting for analysis in queue.
requests.name: Cancel document analysis
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: This method retrieves analysis results for the single document by its unique ID or the document’s status in queue if it did not analyzed yet. Semantria guarantees delivering of all documents back to the client even if they FAILED on Semantria side due to some reason.
requests.name: Retrieve document analysis or its status in queue
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values
